tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tier sm: composer + and mic, search field, list-row and activity leading glyphs, trailing checks, back and exit glyphs in filled 36px header buttons. Phosphor at 20 matches Muse's 17-18 px (muse.ai, 2026-10-19).

tokens.name: size-icon-md

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
